resources.string: Battery reports appear only in the Super Island, for five seconds on connection. Settings are saved on this phone, not to the earbuds. The thresholds below set each ear’s color even when reminders are off.

Enter whole numbers from 1 to 99, with Low below Medium. Below Low is red, Low through Medium is yellow, and above Medium is green. Switches save immediately. Thresholds save when you leave a field or exit this page.
Report when either ear falls to Low, at most once per ear per connection. An initial low reading does not trigger a reminder.
Report when either ear falls to Medium, at most once per ear per connection. This switch is independent of the Low reminder.
Not saved. Both thresholds must be whole numbers from 1 to 99, and Low must be less than Medium. Your saved settings are unchanged.
Your old threshold needs updating. Low is temporarily 20% and Medium 50%; the old settings are kept for recovery. Check these values, then leave a field or this page to confirm.
Could not save battery notification settings on this phone. Your saved settings are unchanged. Try again.
